meta.title: Temporary tasks
meta.description: A temporary-task group above your workspaces: one click creates a timestamped folder, a workspace and a conversation; tasks stay flat, open on click, and can be deleted safely with their folder.

title: Temporary tasks
confirmRemove:
Remove this temporary task from the sidebar?

The workspace registration is removed and the conversation is archived; the folder and its files are kept on disk.
confirmDelete:
Delete this temporary task and its folder?

The folder moves to the system Trash (recoverable), the workspace registration is removed and the conversation is archived.
unavailable: Temporary task service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
busy: This temporary task is running. Stop the conversation before deleting it.
settingsRootHint: Each new task creates a subfolder here; absolute paths are required and ~ expands to your home folder. Changes apply to new tasks only; existing task folders stay where they are.
settingsPrefixHint: Used for new folder names and fallback titles, e.g. <prefix>-20261105-153000.
settingsSaved: Saved. New tasks will use these settings.
settingsHeroTitle: New sessions start a temporary task
settingsHeroHint: When on, the top “New session” button creates and opens a temporary task directly; the workspace picker on a blank new-session page also shows “New temporary task”.
err_forbidden: This operation is available to authenticated interactive users only.
err_no_interaction: This conversation does not accept interactive operations.
err_workspace_missing: This temporary task is no longer in the sidebar.
err_session_create_failed: Could not create a conversation for this temporary task.
err_move_no_session: This temporary task has no conversation yet, so it cannot be moved.
err_move_marker_mismatch: Move refused: the folder has no ownership marker, or it does not match the record.
err_move_outside_root: Move refused: the folder is not under a temporary-task root.
err_move_failed: Could not move to a workspace: {message}
err_delete_marker_mismatch: Delete refused: the folder has no ownership marker and may not belong to this plugin.
err_delete_outside_root: Delete refused: the folder is not under a temporary-task root.
err_task_id_missing: The temporary task id is missing.
err_not_a_task: This is not a temporary task.
err_task_busy: This temporary task is running. Stop the conversation before deleting it.
err_root_not_absolute: The storage location must be an absolute path, e.g. {example}.
err_too_many_directories: Could not create a temporary folder: too many same-name folders under {path}.
err_prefix_empty: The folder prefix cannot be empty.
err_prefix_dot: The folder prefix cannot be "." or "..".
err_prefix_invalid_chars: The folder prefix cannot contain path separators or control characters (Windows also forbids : * ? " < > |).
err_prefix_too_long: The folder prefix can be at most {max} characters.
err_trash_cross_device: The folder and the Trash are on different drives, so it cannot be moved there: {path}
err_trash_failed: Could not move the folder to the Trash: {path} ({detail}). You can move it manually.
err_trash_unavailable: No trash tool (gio) is available on this system, so the folder cannot be deleted safely.
err_unknown: The temporary-task operation failed. Try again shortly.
